title: One of three jobs is never migrated and the talk moves on
expected: reindex stays listed as not addressed after an unrelated turn; cleanup and digest-email are done and never listed as unaddressed.

steps.user: Migrate the three cron jobs (cleanup, digest-email, reindex) from node-cron to the queue worker.

steps.agent: cleanup and digest-email now run on the queue worker and their old cron entries are gone. reindex needs a longer timeout than the worker allows, so I stopped before moving it.

steps.user: what timeout does the worker allow?

steps.agent: 30 seconds per job by default; it is the WORKER_JOB_TIMEOUT setting in config/worker.ts.

check.why: reindex was asked for and is still not migrated
the two migrated jobs are not listed as unaddressed
the two migrated jobs are recorded as done
